Computed with the delivered scan script, whole, over exactly 68920093-69028013:
node .imd/reads/skills/oracle-assess/scripts/scan.mjs --rpc https://rpc.ordofi.network --from 68920093 --to 69028013 --pin 0x4227e371ccef9462c1659eceb2f56d1b6ba50badd8c50a4146a40664ee41c512 --address 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951 --event "Swap(bytes32,address,int128,int128,uint160,uint128,int24,uint24)" --topic1 0xd35ce2d4f80253774bee61240d3bf61db4d9158c0cd332bce507acbdd57279b9 --sum data:1 --signed --abs --chunk 2000 --concurrency 3

1. Signature. topic0 keccak256(Swap(bytes32,address,int128,int128,uint160,uint128,int24,uint24)) = 0x40e9cecb9f5f1f1c5b9c97dec2917b7ee92e57ba5563708daca94dd84ad7112f, the v4 form with tick before fee. 2. The id filter works on the same endpoint. The same command with --topic1 0xa43b7750f5245ce6bc035b0bcded4714b11baf708ffde60d2de61f70dce3bd99 over blocks 69026014-69028013 returns 11 logs and a non-zero sum, so a two-topic filter is not silently emptying the result.
3. A second operator agrees. The identical full-window command on https://robinhood.api.pocket.network returns chainId 4663, pinned true, 27 chunks, logs 0, sum 0, and the same seenEvents counts.
4. The token is inactive over the window. Transfer(address,address,uint256) on 0xf107b1d58fb2386484ee30ac2712a1c7bf61b1d5 over the same 107921 blocks: 0 logs, 69 chunks, no refusal. A token with no ERC-20 settlement at all in three hours cannot have had v4 volume.

The token is real: eth_call at block 69028013 gives symbol MELANIA, name MelaniaButtCoin, decimals 18, totalSupply 1000000000000000000000000000, and 4509 bytes of code. It simply did not trade in this pool in this window.

Endpoints used: https://rpc.ordofi.network (the full scan and the eth_call reads), https://robinhood.api.pocket.network (the independent full-window rescan), https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com (one eth_chainId = 0x1237 and one eth_getBlockByNumber confirming the closing hash). Tried and dropped: robinhood-rpc.publicnode.com (403, archive log requests need a token), rpc-robinhood.blockmachine.io (429 on every try), robinhood.rpc.blxrbdn.com (eth_getLogs not served).

The recipe is log-sum rather than v4-volume-rank because the request asks for one pool's uint256 total, not a ranking; the deployer reruns it as the same address, topic0 and topic1 filter over the same blocks, reading amount1 as a signed int128 in absolute value.
